name: Paradox
overview: Scripture reveals the paradoxical nature of true life and riches in the kingdom of God, where gaining or saving one's life according to worldly values results in loss, but losing one's life for Christ and the gospel leads to true preservation and gain. Proverbs highlights that apparent wealth can be empty while apparent poverty may hold great riches, emphasizing the contrast between earthly and spiritual realities. The teachings of Jesus in Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John consistently affirm that loving or saving one's life in this world leads to loss, whereas self-denial and sacrifice for Christ bring eternal life and true gain.
